prompt:

Composition: landscape 4:3, the complete subject fills about 75% of the frame; centered with ample margins, immediately recognizable when revealed.  
Background: simple uncluttered setting appropriate to the subject, natural lighting.
Constraints: exactly the stated subject; no label, caption, watermark, collage, borders or readable words. Create a sharp original, not a blurred image; the game applies the blur. Keep the entire subject in frame.

review.note: Small astronomical observatory has a silver dome with a large observing slit and a visible telescope above a round building. The open dark slit survives blur. No named site or telescope model is claimed.
